--- BID DIRECT ---
In terms of lvls I’d bid direct: I am holding a 10% long runner from the 730AM 7622 Failed Breakdown, discussed above and that we had yesterday. The current rally in ES was caused by the same thing that causes all rallies: A Failed Breakdown yesterday if 7622. In this case - yesterday morning - ES swept Tuesday’s 7622 low by 4 points, recovered, and ripped. As I discussed extensively yesterday, when ES is in a grind lower mode like we were the last week or so, Failed Breakdowns follow a typical template. We will usually have multiple in a row that only go a level or two, then fail. This is fine, points are points. We saw this for much the week. Then when price is ready, we get a big one that sustains. Since we don’t predict, we can never know which is which nor do we care. We take them all, and the market pays what it wants. The broad picture though remained unchanged from yesterday. ES had been rangebound for a week. The range is heavily contained by the yellow bull flag in the above chart. Resistance was at 7722, and we brokeout today. Support is technically way down at 7587, but inside the range the 7659-49 zone has been key for the last week. We lost that shelf earlier this week and recovered it, then ran. Readers know what I’m going to say here though. My task as a Failed Breakdown trader is very specific: I wait for red. I wait for an elevator down sell, I wait for social media commentary to call for tops etc, then I long the Failed Breakdown, and we rip. After the rip though, there is unfortunately nothing for me to do but wait for the next one. As of writing, 7722 is first support of interest down to backtest the bull flag. --- RESISTANCES ---
Resistances are: 7770 (major), 7782, 7792, 7797 (major), 7805, 7811, 7820, 7828 (major), 7836, 7846, 7859, 7875, 7888-91 (major), 7906, 7914, 7928 (major), 7945, 7953, 7964 (major), 7978, 8004 (major). As readers know I don’t short ES - I only get my points on the long side, but I still give short entries here for those who like them and don’t mind having a substantially lower win rate and lower R/R - SPX is a structurally bullish asset class green 75% of years over the last 100 years with a 1% annualized monthly return and even in bear markets it is extremely hard to short since the sells are short lived, news driven (often random) and resolve in violent rip. I have not had a single short in over a year now - phasing them out after 15 years - and my performance has never been better as my Failed Breakdown strategy outperforms even the strongest shorting strategies in downtrends and uptrends. For those who don’t mind the low win rate associated with shorts, 7797 would be spots to try.

--- BULL CASE ---
Bull case tomorrow: Yesterday, ES put in a Failed Breakdown of Tuesday’s daily low, and we ripped since then. On a more broad perspective, ES had been rangebound for a week. The range is heavily contained by the yellow bull flag in the above chart. Resistance was up at 7722 and we broke out today. Support is technically way down at 7587, but inside the range the 7659-49 zone has been key for the last week. The bull case is simply that we can continue pushing. Ideally, bulls want to defend 7722 on any dips in an ultra bull case (or quick trap below). In a more mild bull case, ES will defend 7670 lowest (or quick trap below). Next set of targets are 7770, 7797 to backtest the early August breakdown. React there, then we head to 7828, then all time highs from there. Given the recent strength, there is minimal spots to add on strength here that would not constitute chasing.

--- BEAR CASE ---
Bear case tomorrow: Begins below 7618. These types of level loss shorts below a support are called breakdown trades. My core edge is failed breakdowns, and the reason is this is an edge is the vast majority of break downs (80%) trap. I do not take these trades personally. They take great skill to execute, and even when done well by a trader who has mastered these setups, one should expect over 60% to fail (they are low win rate, high R/R trades. 2 or 3 in a row will fail, then the 4th will pay out huge). *If you don’t like these odds and cant tolerate being trapped - simply don’t take them. I consider breakdown trades to be an advanced setup type so if a newer subscriber, there is nothing wrong with passing on these. For the 7618 short, ideally one can put in a final bounce or here, OR a Failed Breakdown then one can short beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7613 trigger down.

--- SUMMARY ---
In summary for tomorrow: Yesterday, ES put in a Failed Breakdown of Tuesday’s daily low, and we ripped since then. On a more broad perspective, ES had been rangebound for a week. The range is heavily contained by the yellow bull flag in the above chart. Resistance is now up at 7722 and we broke out today. Support is technically way down at 7587, but inside the range the 7659-49 zone has been key for the last week. My general lean is we continue to 7771, 7797.

As always no crystal balls, no guessing, no predicting. I’ll be trading the above plan following whatever path price chooses. Reacting level to level, one move at a time, take profits, reset bias from scratch. Not choosing the path for price ahead of time, and hoping it agrees with me. *You don’t need an opinion on where price is going to make money*.
